Meta.title: Previously — Previously on you.
Meta.description: an open-source personal AI agent that remembers by when, not by chat thread — a single timeline of episodic time slices

Hero.title: Your AI, organized by time — not by threads.
Hero.subtitle: an open-source personal AI agent that remembers by when, not by chat thread — a single timeline of episodic time slices

Screen2.title: Time, not conversations.
Screen2.description: Most AI agents organize your content by conversation threads. Previously has no conversations — just one continuous relationship on a single timeline of time slices, where every moment has its place.
Screen2.legendText: Strands connect related topics across time

Screen3.title: A memory that learns about you.
Screen3.description: Previously keeps a compact user card — identity, profile, recent work — that evolves as you talk. Once per closed slice it refines how it understands you: not a bloated dossier, just what matters.
Screen3.legend: Evolving understanding — observe, reinforce, correct, expire

Screen4.title: Nothing happens in a black box.
Screen4.description: Thinking, recall, and every tool call stream inline as the answer arrives. You watch the agent reason, scan your timeline, and deep-read the slices that matter — before it answers.
Screen4.phase1Detail: Scanning recent slice summaries for pointers
Screen4.phase2Detail: Reading the slices that matter, in full
Screen4.cursorText: recalling what you decided about the housing project…

Screen5.title: Travel back to any moment.
Screen5.description: Click any point on your timeline and you're there — reliving that conversation, seeing what the agent was thinking, picking up exactly where you left off. Not search. Not scroll. Time travel.

Screen6.title: Your memory. Your repository.
Screen6.description: Every conversation is a Markdown file in your own GitHub repo. No proprietary database. No cloud lock-in. No one else's server. Your data, your format, your control — forever.

Screen7.title: It works while you're away.
Screen7.description: Every turn is a durable run — close the tab, lock your phone, drop the connection, and the agent keeps going. When you come back, it re-attaches and shows you what you missed. Background loops work the same way.

Screen8.title: Open source. Self-host. No lock-in.
Screen8.description: MIT licensed. Run it on your own machine. Modify it. Extend it. Contribute back. Previously belongs to the community, not a corporation.

Screen9.title: Previously on you.
Screen9.description: Your AI, organized by time — not by threads. Open source. Self-hosted. Always yours.
